description: This file defines the MpesaSettings class and related functions for handling M-Pesa payment integration within the ERPNext system, including payment request handling, transaction verification, account balance retrieval, and callback processing.

classes.name: MpesaSettings
classes.description: Represents the M-Pesa payment gateway settings and handles payment processing, transaction verification, and account balance retrieval.

methods.name: validate_transaction_currency
methods.description: Validates if the transaction currency is supported.

methods.name: on_update
methods.description: Performs actions when the settings are updated, such as creating custom fields and payment gateway.

methods.name: request_for_payment
methods.description: Initiates a payment request, splitting amounts if necessary, and handles API responses.

methods.name: split_request_amount_according_to_transaction_limit
methods.description: Splits a large request amount into smaller requests based on transaction limit.

methods.name: get_account_balance_info
methods.description: Fetches account balance information from M-Pesa.

methods.name: handle_api_response
methods.description: Handles responses from API calls, logging requests and errors.
